title: Protection & Covering
intro: Small children need to hear that they are safe far more often than adults think, and they need it in words that do not promise more than is true. This month says: you are watched, you are kept, you can always tell us, and there is somewhere to run.

keyScriptures.text: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge.
The Lord will watch over your coming and going.

weeks.title: You Are Watched Over
weeks.declaration: Someone is looking after you all the time, even when you cannot see anyone. He does not go to sleep.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, watch over this child in every room we are not in. Amen.

weeks.title: You Can Always Tell Us
weeks.declaration: There is nothing too big or too bad to tell us. Nothing you say will make us stop loving you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make us safe to tell. Keep our faces kind when our child brings us something hard. Amen.

weeks.title: Somewhere to Run
weeks.declaration: When you are frightened, you can run to us and you can run to God. Both doors are always open.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, be the first place our child runs, not the last. Amen.

weeks.title: Kept Safe
weeks.declaration: You are kept. That means someone is holding on to you on purpose and does not intend to let go.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, keep this child all their life, and keep us faithful in praying it. Amen.

days.title: Watched Over
days.declaration: Someone is looking after you all the time, even when you cannot see anyone.

scripture.text: He who watches over you will not slumber.

days.title: Under His Wings
days.declaration: There is a safe place close by. You can go there any time.

scripture.text: Under his wings you will find refuge.

days.title: Tell Us Anything
days.declaration: There is nothing too big to tell us. Nothing will make us love you less.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him.

days.title: Somewhere to Run
days.declaration: When you are scared, run to us. And you can talk to God from anywhere.

scripture.text: The righteous run to it and are safe.

days.title: Safe in Bed
days.declaration: You are safe in your bed. Someone is awake who never needs to sleep.

scripture.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep.

days.title: We Come Back
days.declaration: When we leave, we come back. That has always happened and it always will.

scripture.text: Never will I leave you.

days.title: Safe Grown-Ups
days.declaration: Some grown-ups are safe and some are not. We will help you know the difference.

scripture.text: The prudent see danger and take refuge.

days.title: No Secrets That Hurt
days.declaration: If a grown-up asks you to keep a secret that feels wrong, tell us. Always.

scripture.text: Rather expose them.

days.title: Your Body Is Yours
days.declaration: Your body belongs to you. You can say no to hugs you do not want.

scripture.text: Your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit.

days.title: Holding Hands
days.declaration: Holding hands near roads is not because you are little. It is because we love you.

scripture.text: Guard your heart.

days.title: God Sees in the Dark
days.declaration: God can see perfectly in the dark. Nothing is hidden from Him.

scripture.text: Even the darkness will not be dark to you.

days.title: Hard Things Happen
days.declaration: Sometimes hard things happen anyway. You will never face them on your own.

scripture.text: I will be with you.

days.title: Angels Are Real
days.declaration: God sends help you cannot see. You are looked after more than you know.

scripture.text: He will command his angels concerning you.

days.title: This House Is Safe
days.declaration: This house is a safe place. You can put down whatever the day was like.

scripture.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High.

days.title: Held When You Fall
days.declaration: When you fall over, you are picked up. You are not left there.

scripture.text: The Lord upholds him with his hand.

days.title: Not Your Job to Worry
days.declaration: Worrying is not your job. You are allowed to be little and let us carry it.

scripture.text: Do not worry about tomorrow.

days.title: Nothing Surprises God
days.declaration: Nothing that happens today is a surprise to God. He is already there.

scripture.text: You hem me in behind and before.

days.title: Peace at Bedtime
days.declaration: God gives a quiet feeling for the end of the day. You can ask for it.

scripture.text: The peace of God will guard your hearts.

days.title: When Someone Is Unkind
days.declaration: If someone is unkind to you, that is about them. You are still safe and still loved.

scripture.text: No weapon forged against you will prevail.

days.title: Doctors Help
days.declaration: Doctors and nurses are helpers, even when it hurts a bit. We stay with you.

scripture.text: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed.

days.title: You Can Say No
days.declaration: You are allowed to say no to things that feel wrong, even to grown-ups.

scripture.text: Daniel resolved not to defile himself.

days.title: Kept When You Are Out
days.declaration: You are looked after at nursery and at the park, not only at home.

scripture.text: The Lord will watch over your coming and going.

days.title: A Strong Tower
days.declaration: There is a safe place that nothing can knock down. You can always run there.

scripture.text: The Lord is my rock, my fortress.

days.title: Rest Is Safe
days.declaration: You can stop and rest. Nothing falls apart when you do.

scripture.text: I will give you rest.

days.title: We Pray for You
days.declaration: We pray for you when you are asleep and when you are out. You are covered.

scripture.text: Pray for each other.

days.title: Never Thrown Away
days.declaration: You will never be sent away or given up on. Not for anything.

scripture.text: Nothing can separate us from the love of God.

days.title: Being Brave and Safe
days.declaration: Being safe does not mean staying still. You are covered so you can go and do things.

scripture.text: He brought me out into a spacious place.

days.title: God Is Bigger
days.declaration: Whatever is scary, God is bigger than it. That is always true.

scripture.text: Greater is he that is in you.

days.title: Kept
days.declaration: You are kept. Someone is holding on to you on purpose.

scripture.text: The Lord bless you and keep you.

days.title: Safe to Be Little
days.declaration: You are allowed to be little. Nobody needs you to be big yet.

scripture.text: He gathers the lambs in his arms.

days.title: Still Safe Tomorrow
days.declaration: All of this is still true tomorrow. Nothing about it wears off.

scripture.text: Both now and forevermore.
